description: nf-core/viralmetagenome samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 1.1.3 nextflow_schema.json and assets/schema_input.json. Untargeted viral genome reconstruction with iSNV detection.

pipeline.name: nf-core/viralmetagenome
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. sample and fastq_1 are required.
pipeline.reference_requirement: NONE. The 1.1.3 schema declares no genome/fasta/gtf parameter — reconstruction is de novo, which is the point: it finds viruses without being told which to look for.

validation_rules: Do NOT pass --genome, --fasta or --gtf: the 1.1.3 schema declares none of them.
Use this when the virus is UNKNOWN. If the target virus is known, viralrecon gives a better-constrained answer.
Input should be a shotgun metagenomic library. An amplicon library sent here reconstructs only what the primers targeted, which is not what the output implies.
notes: NO MATCHING DATA IN NExtSEEK as of 2026-08-05: no registered viral or viral-metagenomic cohorts (19 viral mentions across 51,359 samples, none a sequencing cohort). Catalogued for future data.

sources.label: nf-core/viralmetagenome nextflow_schema.json @ 1.1.3
sources.notes: Authoritative: no required params beyond input/outdir; no genome/fasta/gtf.

sources.label: nf-core/viralmetagenome assets/schema_input.json @ 1.1.3
sources.notes: Authoritative columns: sample and fastq_1 required.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/viralmetagenome input sheet.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/viralmetagenome sheet from a resolved D.SEQ cohort of shotgun metagenomic libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected when the user wants to find and reconstruct viruses without naming one in advance.
population_priority: Confirm the library is untargeted shotgun, not amplicon.
If the user already knows which virus they are after, suggest viralrecon instead.
final_checks: Every row has a non-empty sample and fastq_1.
